Notes_and_Tips: Start meals with chicken, eggs or paneer before eating rice to support fat loss.
Avoid fried and spicy outside food, especially during late nights.
Fix dinner timing early to reduce fat storage from late-night eating.
Consistent meal timing will improve energy and help body fat reduction.
Include vegetables daily for better digestion and overall health.
